title: Muse browser QA and centered queue buttons
summary: Add Start Muse QA in Office, require exact-build screenshots for browser QA completion, and center Confirm and Check in labels in the app and marketing capture.
source: Committed review plan for Muse browser QA and front-desk button alignment.

scenarios.title: Start Muse QA from Office
scenarios.description: Office gains a manual trigger for the same bounded browser QA route used after publishing.
scenarios.instructions: Compare Original and Changed. Changed shows Start Muse QA near the coverage grid. Public visitors see it disabled with a sign-in explanation. On the published build, an Office operator can start one run; an active request disables duplicate submission.
scenarios.expected: The control explains access, shows task status, and never reports missing browser evidence as verified. Local preview requests must not run against a different live build.
steps: The QA trigger and access explanation are clear.
Queued, blocked and evidence-missing states are distinguishable.

scenarios.title: Compare the front-desk button image
scenarios.description: The marketing image reflects the current queue with text-only Confirm and Check in buttons.
scenarios.instructions: Toggle Original and Changed. Inspect all three populated morning rows. The updated image also reflects the current queue layout and readiness information.
scenarios.expected: Both labels are centered without a checkmark, and all actions remain readable.
steps: Confirm is centered in all three rows.
Check in is centered in all three rows.

scenarios.title: Keep the blue sandbox journey working
scenarios.description: The blue button remains the bounded smoke check for post-publish browser QA.
scenarios.instructions: Hover and keyboard-focus Try Our Sandbox, then activate it. After publishing, watch Office for Muse pickup and stored screenshots.
scenarios.expected: The hero remains blue, hover and focus are visible, /demo opens, and automatic QA stores exact-build screenshots or reports an actionable blocker.
steps: Blue button hover and focus remain visible.
